title: New Mexico Statutes Annotated 1978, Chapter 59A - New Mexico Insurance Code
verified_how: Fetched the NM OneSource chapter page (item 4438, '?iframe=true' form) in a browser on 23 September 2026: page title 'Chapter 59A - Insurance Code - NMOneSource.com', collection 'Current New Mexico Statutes Annotated 1978', date 2026; the table of contents opens with 'ARTICLE 1 Insurance Code' and includes 'ARTICLE 16 Trade Practices and Frauds' and 'ARTICLE 18 The Insurance Contract', none marked repealed. The superseded chapter is separately listed in the collection as 'Chapter 59 - Insurance [Repealed.]', confirming 59A is the live code.
notes: Claim handling is governed within the Insurance Code: Article 16 contains the unfair claims practices provisions (the Trade Practices and Frauds article, source of New Mexico's statutory bad-faith claim) and Article 18 the general insurance-contract rules. Chapter 59A is recorded as the principal consolidated statute because the Code is a single enacted code rather than a set of separate Acts.
